title: NVTT quote
excerpt: I love this quote from Ivan-Assen Ivanov about the NVIDIA Texture Tools: We switched to CUDA nvcompress in our pipeline and totally forgot about it. Until yesterday, when an artist had to work on a 7600 for a while, and raised hell about how slow the export has become. :-)
content:
I love this quote from Ivan-Assen Ivanov about the NVIDIA Texture Tools:

We switched to CUDA nvcompress in our pipeline and totally forgot
about it. Until yesterday, when an artist had to work on a 7600 for a
while, and raised hell about how slow the export has become.

:-)
